enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in bed with the air conditioner on low
enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns over. Adjusts pillow. Pulls blanket up. Remains asleep. Turns again. Stretches. Remains asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, using the toilet, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Sits up in bed. Swings legs out of bed. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Lifts toilet lid. Urinates. Flushes toilet. Lowers toilet lid. Turns on tap. Wets hands. Picks up soap. Rubs hands. Rinses hands. Turns off tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Spits into sink. Turns on tap. Rinses toothbrush. Turns off tap. Picks up towel. Wipes face. Hangs towel. Turns off bathroom light. Walks out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast: toast, cereal and coffee using the kettle and toaster
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk. Takes out bread. Takes out cereal box. Places bread in toaster. Presses toaster lever. Fills kettle with water. Turns on kettle. Takes bowl from cupboard. Pours cereal into bowl. Pours milk into bowl. Takes spoon from drawer. Eats cereal. Drinks milk from bowl. Takes plate from cupboard. Takes butter from refrigerator. Spreads butter on toast. Eats toast. Takes mug from cupboard. Pours coffee into mug. Adds milk to coffee. Drinks coffee. Washes dishes. Puts dishes in dish rack. Wipes counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag and phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Takes out shirt. Takes out trousers. Takes out socks. Takes out shoes. Closes wardrobe. Puts on shirt. Puts on trousers. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Picks up work bag. Opens work bag. Picks up phone from nightstand. Places phone in work bag. Zips work bag. Picks up work bag. Walks out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the workday by public transport/walking
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bus stop. Checks phone for bus schedule. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Taps transit card. Finds seat. Sits down. Rides bus. Pulls cord for stop. Stands up. Exits bus. Walks to hospital. Enters hospital. Walks to locker room. Changes into work shoes. Walks to department.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a physiotherapist: assessing patients and running rehabilitation sessions
enriched_activities.desc: Greets patient. Reviews patient chart. Asks patient questions. Observes patient movement. Demonstrates exercise. Assists patient with exercise. Adjusts patient position. Applies resistance. Takes notes. Uses computer to update records. Walks to next patient. Repeats assessment. Sets up equipment. Cleans equipment. Washes hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break in the hospital staff room
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to staff room. Opens locker. Takes out lunch bag. Closes locker. Sits at table. Opens lunch bag. Takes out sandwich. Unwraps sandwich. Eats sandwich. Drinks water from bottle. Talks with colleague. Wipes mouth with napkin. Throws away trash. Puts lunch bag back in locker.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a physiotherapist: continuing patient treatment sessions and writing clinical notes
enriched_activities.desc: Greets patient. Escorts patient to treatment area. Assists patient onto treatment table. Performs manual therapy. Instructs patient on exercises. Monitors patient progress. Uses computer to write notes. Types on keyboard. Reads previous notes. Saves notes. Walks to next patient. Repeats treatment. Cleans treatment area. Washes hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the hospital by public transport/walking
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Taps transit card. Finds seat. Sits down. Rides bus. Pulls cord. Stands up. Exits bus. Walks to home. Unlocks front door. Enters home. Closes door. Locks door. Takes off shoes. Puts on slippers.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and eating at the table
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Washes hands. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables. Takes out meat. Takes out cutting board. Takes out knife. Cuts vegetables. Cuts meat. Turns on induction cooker. Places pan on cooker. Pours oil into pan. Adds vegetables to pan. Adds meat to pan. Stirs with spatula. Adds seasoning. Turns off induction cooker. Places food on plate. Carries plate to table. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Clears table. Washes dishes. Puts dishes in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower with the water heater and changing into comfortable clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on water heater. Removes clothes. Places clothes in hamper. Steps into shower. Turns on shower. Wets body. Applies soap. Washes body. Rinses body. Applies shampoo. Washes hair. Rinses hair. Turns off shower. Steps out of shower. Picks up towel. Dries body. Dries hair. Wraps towel around waist. Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Takes out comfortable clothes. Puts on comfortable clothes. Hangs towel.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV with the air conditioner on
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Turns on air conditioner. Sits on sofa. Changes channels. Watches TV. Gets up. Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out snack. Returns to living room. Sits on sofa. Eats snack. Continues watching TV. Changes channels. Turns off TV. Turns off air conditioner. Stands up. Walks out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing physiotherapy literature and professional notes on the computer under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to study. Turns on desk lamp. Turns on computer. Sits on chair. Opens document. Reads literature. Scrolls down. Takes notes. Types on keyboard. Highlights text. Saves document. Turns off computer. Turns off desk lamp. Stands up. Walks out of study.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down: setting out clothes for tomorrow and checking the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Takes out shirt. Takes out trousers. Takes out socks. Takes out shoes. Lays clothes on chair. Closes wardrobe. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Checks messages. Scrolls through apps. Puts phone on nightstand. Turns on air conditioner. Turns off light.
Lies in bed. Pulls blanket up. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns over. Adjusts pillow. Remains asleep. Turns again. Stretches. Remains asleep.
